Requirement: The power subsystem shall provide a regulated 28 V bus within 0.5 V during eclipse.
The power subsystem should shed loads when the battery state of charge falls below 30 %.
The attitude control subsystem will hold the boresight within 0.2 deg during imaging.
The communications subsystem shall transmit health telemetry at 4 kbps.
The spacecraft shall demonstrate a transition to safe mode when the operator sends the command.
The structure shall withstand a random vibration of 9.9 grms without structural failure.
The spacecraft shall provide a reliability of at least 90 % over a 2 year on-orbit life.
External connectors shall be labelled with the interface identifier.
The flight software shall comply with the project software design standard.
The thermal control subsystem shall keep the battery between 0 °C and 30 °C in operational modes.
The spacecraft shall be robust and user-friendly.
The propulsion subsystem shall provide TBD N of thrust.
